title: Recover IFX 1.1.4 C6c matrix and expiring-lock readiness
goal: Correct the two proven preflight gaps from the failed 0.4.1 C6c, produce a fresh deterministic 0.4.2 candidate, and stop before any new full C6c attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: The historical failed C6c attempt and its evidence remain unchanged.
The C6c4 matrix contract projection and seven changed adapter hashes match the current ordinal inventory, and the fixture specification binds the corrected contract.
A readiness gate validates the clean Target commit, inventory and candidate identities, all seven lock hashes and commits, and at least 2700 seconds of remaining life for every expiring lock.
A recovered single-C6c wrapper uses distinct evidence paths, refuses path reuse, and requires an explicit authorization switch before writing an attempt marker.
Fresh locks and two independent 0.4.2 compositions bind the exact recovery Target commit and are deterministic.
Contract, focused qualification and readiness checks pass without running a full C6c.
